record: SR.4 crosswalk for the two derived p values at v7 section 5.3, the L18 registered-test p values quoted as .92 and .45.
LABEL: DERIVATION of a REGISTERED test statistic from a serialized delta_z. No new measurement. Re-grades nothing (SR.7).
procedure: z_stat = delta_z / SE_registered, two-sided normal p = erfc(|z_stat|/sqrt(2)). SE_registered = sqrt(2/(45-3)), the single-pair Fisher SE on the 45-emotion Russell and Mehrabian overlap.
basis: 100T. Cleaned analysis-layer vectors, 2B read at L18, 27B at L31.
draft_claim_checked: v7 section 5.3: "Neither rise clears the registered floor of .15, and the registered test is not significant in either chain (p = .92 and .45)."

base_chain_delta_z_corroboration.note: Agreement is bounded by the 7-figure precision at which the artifact's flag states r_2b_base. The tuned chain's component correlations are not serialized anywhere, so its delta_z rests on the artifact's own reproduction gate alone.
